subject: general
question: Which article of the Indian constitution provides for proclamation of Emergency?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 352.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 352 **of the Indian Constitution deals with the proclamation of Emergency.
 
• **This article empowers the President of India to declare a state of emergency in the country in case of war, external aggression, or armed rebellion.**
 
• **The Emergency can be declared for the whole country or a specific state or union territory.**
 
• During the Emergency, the** fundamental rights of citizens **can be suspended, and the central government takes over the administration of the affected state or the entire country.
 
• The Emergency can be** **revoked by the President after receiving the approval of both houses of Parliament.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• **Article 364** of the Indian Constitution deals with the** appointment of an Inter-State Council** to promote coordination between states.
 
• **Article 350** deals with the appointment of a** special officer for linguistic minorities.**
 
• **Article 362** deals with the** rights of tribal people** over their land and resources.
